text:
maria.c: FYI - ACME reported multiple project admins suddenly getting 403s in the console and failing to create API keys after an IdP change earlier today. They say it started after the Okta team normalized role claims.
kevin: can you paste repro steps + a failing curl or console error? need customer org id too.
maria.c: Repro steps from customer: 1) Sign in via SSO. 2) Switch to org ACME (org-abc). 3) Open Project > Settings > API Keys. 4) Click Create API Key -> instant 403 popup. API request to our backend returns 403 with body: `{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "reason": "missing role: project_admin"
}`
sam: can repro locally with a test user if I craft a token that lacks the `roles` claim. Posting token payload snippet they sent: ```{
  "sub": "user:123",
  "email": "jane@acme.com",
  "app_roles": ["viewer"],
  "scp": ["openid"]
}``` note: claim name changed to `app_roles` instead of `roles`.
maria.c: customer says Okta change renamed the claim to `app_roles` and removed `roles` entirely for some groups during normalization.
support_sre: backend log when I replayed request: `authz DENY user=jane@acme.com resource=project:proj-123 action=create_api_key reason=missing_role(project_admin)` — confirms our check looks specifically for claim `roles`.
kevin: looks like mapping mismatch. two options: (1) ask IdP to restore `roles` claim, or (2) our intermediate token-mapper needs to map `app_roles` -> `roles` for that IdP connection.
eng-oncall-bot: deploy/12345 finished :white_check_mark: (not related but posting current deploy window).
support_sre: short-term workaround for ACME: org owners can add the user to the project with the UI (inviting by email) which creates a server-side binding not reliant on the SSO claim. That will restore project_admin rights immediately. Long-term we need to update claim mapping.
maria.c: customer accepted the manual add workaround and I asked their IdP team to reintroduce `roles` or to add mapping. They've agreed to a SCIM/group resync too.
kevin: I'll open an internal task to add flexible claim mapping for Okta providers (map alt claim names -> canonical `roles`) and a one-off admin endpoint to resync rolebindings per org. Filing: ENG-9876.
sam: adding notes for Support KB: reproduce steps + recommended workaround + sample jwt payloads. tagging @support_sre for any followups. :eyes:
support_sre: follow-up: also suggest a short circuit in auth that looks for equivalent claims `roles`, `app_roles`, `workspace_roles` for legacy IdPs. Will add to ENG-9876.
maria.c: thanks — I'll update the customer and mark thread as resolved once they confirm the manual invite fixed access.
